name: liquid-gradient
title: Liquid Gradient
description: Seven overlapping gradient sheets blend into a slow, liquid rainbow that keeps reshaping. In the demo it fills a rounded pill behind the words Get early access and slows down while hovered.
use: A signup or early-access CTA needs to feel animated and eye-catching without extra illustration.
avoid: The motion cannot be paused, and the fixed rainbow palette may fight a restrained brand.
a11y: The gradient never stops and ignores reduced-motion, and the pill is a plain div without button semantics. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A wide pill-shaped banner on a black page, filled edge to edge with layered rainbow gradients — hot pink, orange, green, cyan and violet — that curve and fold like fabric. Centred white bold text sits on top.
behaves: The gradient morphs and reshapes on a continuous ten-second loop, never sitting still. Hovering stretches the same motion over a fifty-second cycle, so the colours drift much more slowly while the label stays fixed.
customise: Seventeen colour slots are passed as a colors object, and isHovered toggles the slow cycle. The pill size, label and layout live in the demo rather than the component.
weight: moderate: Seven layered SVG gradients animate dozens of stops every frame.
demo: A white label reading Get early access on the gradient pill.
issues: The pill looks like a button but is a plain div with no click action or keyboard focus.
White label loses contrast where the brightest yellow and green bands pass behind it.
polishWhy: Rich, smooth flowing colour; the white label dips in contrast over the brightest bands.
